name: dotted-map
title: Dotted Map
description: A dotted world map built from thousands of small circles, with pulsing orange markers placed at given latitudes and longitudes.
use: A page should show worldwide locations or coverage without pulling in a heavy interactive map.
avoid: When people must pan, zoom or click a location; this is a still graphic with decorative pulses.
a11y: The SVG has no title or description, so neither the map nor its markers reach a screen reader. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a world map is formed by thousands of tiny grey dots packed in rows, continents legible through their density. Each marked city is a solid orange dot wrapped in one or two thin orange rings.
behaves: The dots hold still while every marker keeps sending out one or two rings that expand and fade on a loop. Nothing responds to the pointer, and the pulses never settle.
customise: Markers come as an array of latitude, longitude, size and pulse; map size, dot count, dot radius, colours and a custom marker overlay are props.
weight: moderate: Thousands of SVG circles plus eight endlessly looping SMIL pulse rings.
demo: Eight pulsing city markers spread across the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia
issues: Frames 1 and 2 show a completely empty stage; the map only appears from the third frame.
polishWhy: The dots render evenly and the orange pulses sit well; the blank opening frames are a blemish.
